acceptance_rule: Pass if aggregate EV and sleeve PnL improve, EV and PnL improve in all three windows, max drawdown worsens by no more than 0.5 percentage points in any window, sleeve closed trades >= 40, and cash-flow forecast-context closed trades >= 20.
